naf70610b4ff.s: On 15 August 1947, Mahatma Gandhi was fasting and praying at:
naf70610b4ff.x: Gandhi spent 15 August 1947 at Beliaghata in Calcutta, fasting and praying, rather than attending the Delhi celebrations.

nindian-history-105-24.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Attlee's announcement on transfer of power – 3 June 1947
nindian-history-105-24.x: The first Interim Government was formed on 2 September 1946. Attlee's announcement was 20 February 1947, the Mountbatten Plan 3 June 1947 and Independence 15 August 1947.

n0155d63a734.s: The Congress accepted partition in 1947 mainly to:
o: retain British paramountcy over the princely states
prevent the formation of two dominions
avoid Balkanisation, secure a strong Centre and end communal bloodshed
n0155d63a734.x: Congress accepted partition to avoid Balkanisation, establish a strong Centre and bring an end to communal bloodshed.

n216be042347.s: Transfer of power to India and Pakistan as dominions enabled them to:
o: become free before framing their constitutions
remain provinces under the British Parliament
n216be042347.x: Dominion status let India and Pakistan become free before their constitutions were written, giving an interim constitutional position during the transition.

nindian-history-105-32.s: Clement R. Attlee, British Prime Minister at the time of Indian independence, belonged to the:
nindian-history-105-32.x: Clement Attlee led the British Labour Party and was Prime Minister from 1945 to 1951.

n1a93bceb8f2.s: Who described Mahatma Gandhi as a 'one-man boundary force'?
n1a93bceb8f2.x: Lord Mountbatten called Gandhi a 'one-man boundary force' because of his efforts to restrain communal violence.

n4deb4410201.s: The 1947 referendum in the North-West Frontier Province was boycotted by the:
n4deb4410201.x: The Khudai Khidmatgar movement boycotted the referendum, and the North-West Frontier Province joined Pakistan.

nb6c062a6235.s: Sir Cyril Radcliffe, who chaired the Boundary Commissions in 1947, was:
o: an Indian judge experienced in provincial administration
the Governor-General who supervised the partition
a British lawyer with no knowledge of Indian conditions beyond the map
a Muslim League nominee on the Boundary Commission
nb6c062a6235.x: Radcliffe was a British lawyer who lacked knowledge of Indian conditions beyond the map when he chaired the Boundary Commissions.

n1ea5dddc784.s: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was born on 14 April 1891 at:
n1ea5dddc784.x: Ambedkar was born on 14 April 1891 at Mhow (now Dr. Ambedkar Nagar, Madhya Pradesh) in a Mahar family.

nindian-history-98-17.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Nehru–Liaquat Pact of April 1950 is also known as the Delhi Pact.
2. The Gandhi–Irwin Pact of March 1931 is also known as the Delhi Pact.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-history-98-17.x: Both pacts were signed in Delhi and both are called the Delhi Pact: the Nehru–Liaquat agreement of April 1950 and the Gandhi–Irwin Pact of 5 March 1931.

nindian-history-99-5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Round Table Conferences?
o: The First RTC was held from November 1930 to January 1931.
The Second RTC was held from 7 September to 1 December 1931.
The Congress participated in the Third RTC.
Ambedkar demanded separate electorates for the Depressed Classes at the First RTC.
nindian-history-99-5.x: The Congress did not take part in the Third RTC of 1932, as it had resumed Civil Disobedience. The other statements are correct.

nindian-history-99-11.shape: one-liner (match grid not needed; nearest honest shape)
nindian-history-99-11.s: Who among the following attended the First Round Table Conference?
nindian-history-99-11.x: Jinnah attended the First RTC. Gandhi, Sarojini Naidu and Malaviya stayed away because the Congress boycotted it, and attended only the Second.

n97a43c82021.s: Under the Poona Pact (1932), the reserved seats for the Depressed Classes in provincial legislatures were increased from 71 to:
n97a43c82021.x: The Poona Pact dropped separate electorates for joint electorates with reserved seats, raising the provincial seats from 71 to 148.

na03dbe938c2.s: Which of the following correctly contrasts Gandhi's and Ambedkar's approaches to caste?
o: Gandhi: annihilate caste through law; Ambedkar: retain varna
Gandhi: reform Hinduism, retain varna, use 'Harijan'; Ambedkar: annihilate caste through law and political power
Both: retain varna and avoid political action
Both: same approach, differing only in terminology
na03dbe938c2.x: Gandhi sought to reform Hinduism, retain varna and used the term 'Harijan'; Ambedkar sought the annihilation of caste through legal and political means.

n235dd886839.s: The Draft Constitution, published in February 1948, contained how many Articles?
n235dd886839.x: The Draft Constitution was published on 21 February 1948 and contained 315 Articles.

n60021a4ddb7.s: Before Partition, Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was elected to the Constituent Assembly from:
n60021a4ddb7.x: Before Partition, Ambedkar was elected from Bengal's Jessore-Khulna area with the support of Jogendra Nath Mandal.

nfc802358810.s: Ambedkar later felt that the Poona Pact made the Dalits:
o: independent of caste Hindus in political matters
nfc802358810.x: Ambedkar later felt the Pact made Dalits dependent on caste Hindus, although he had accepted joint electorates during the negotiations.

n102c9c1f3f1.s: Rejecting Gandhi's Gram Swaraj and trusteeship, Ambedkar advocated:
n102c9c1f3f1.x: Ambedkar rejected Gram Swaraj and trusteeship, favouring a strong, centralised constitutional democracy to protect minorities.

n0b8a67cfe15.s:
Consider the following statements about separate electorates in 1932:
1. Gandhi opposed separate electorates for the Depressed Classes.
2. Ambedkar demanded separate electorates but settled for reserved seats under the Poona Pact.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n0b8a67cfe15.x: Gandhi opposed separate electorates and fasted in 1932; Ambedkar demanded them but ultimately settled for reserved seats under the Poona Pact.

n96d82e21cd2.s: Where did B.R. Ambedkar declare in October 1935 that, though born a Hindu, he would not die a Hindu?
n96d82e21cd2.x: Ambedkar made this declaration at the Depressed Classes Conference at Yeola on 13 October 1935.

nc55d572c1b9.s: The strength of the Constituent Assembly fell from 389 to 299 mainly because of the:
o: withdrawal of Muslim League members from areas that went to Pakistan
nc55d572c1b9.x: After Partition, Muslim League members from territories that became part of Pakistan withdrew, reducing the strength from 389 to 299.

n17a5e7f223c.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with reference to the Constituent Assembly?
n17a5e7f223c.x: B.N. Rau was the Constitutional Adviser; H.C. Mukherjee was Vice-President and B.R. Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee.

nfa36c9873bf.s: Jana Gana Mana was first sung at the Indian National Congress session held at:
nfa36c9873bf.x: Jana Gana Mana was first sung at the Calcutta session of the INC on 27 December 1911.

n7a3c042999b.s: Pingali Venkayya, born in 1876 at Bhatlapenumarru, was popularly known as:
n7a3c042999b.x: Pingali Venkayya, born in 1876 at Bhatlapenumarru, is popularly known as Jhanda Venkayya.

nbd8b30028bd.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Gandhi favoured a decentralised village and cottage-industry economy.
2. Nehru favoured heavy industry, science and central planning.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nbd8b30028bd.x: Gandhi emphasised decentralised villages and cottage industries, whereas Nehru supported heavy industry, science and central planning.

na020d93da3a.s: Who was the first Deputy Chairman of the Planning Commission?
na020d93da3a.x: Gulzarilal Nanda was the first Deputy Chairman; Nehru, as Prime Minister, was the ex officio Chairman and M.S. Ahluwalia the last Deputy Chairman.

n381d0016cd8.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Third Five Year Plan – Gadgil Yojana
First Five Year Plan – Mahalanobis model
Second Five Year Plan – Harrod-Domar model
Second Five Year Plan – Gadgil Yojana
n381d0016cd8.x: The Third Plan was called the Gadgil Yojana; the First Plan used the Harrod-Domar model and the Second the Mahalanobis model.

nac4f37a182c.s: After the failure of the Third Five Year Plan, the 'Plan Holiday' with three annual plans lasted from:
nac4f37a182c.x: The Third Plan's failure led to the Plan Holiday of 1966–69, with three annual plans and a devaluation of the rupee.

n7d02823d0f1.s: Article 343 made Hindi in Devanagari script the official language and allowed English to continue for:
n7d02823d0f1.x: Article 343 made Hindi in the Devanagari script the official language and provided for the use of English for 15 years.

n46ecd9b219d.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Deshabhimani – Propaganda by the Vizag district committee
Andhra Advocate – The Andhra movement can serve national unity
Janmabhumi – Protection of Telugu culture through its own government
Andhra Patrika – Popularisation of the word 'Andhra'
n46ecd9b219d.x: Andhra Patrika popularised the word 'Andhra'. Deshabhimani argued for protecting Telugu culture through its own government, Andhra Advocate was used for propaganda and Janmabhumi linked the movement with national unity.

n8db19f01208.s: Replying to Tamil opposition, an Andhra Patrika writer argued that Tamils separating from Telugus would:
n8db19f01208.x: The Andhra Patrika writer argued that Tamils separating from Telugus would not harm national unity.

n6e77e8b5efc.s: At the Nellore session of 1917, 480 of the 740 delegates came from Nellore. Voting was therefore conducted:
n6e77e8b5efc.x: Since 480 of the 740 delegates came from Nellore, voting was conducted district-wise to avoid domination by one district.

n1ae76946133.s: Which of the following pairs (Andhra Mahasabha session – President) is correctly matched?
n1ae76946133.x: Mocherla Ramachandra Rao presided over the fourth session. The second, third and sixth were presided over by Nyapati Subba Rao, Panuganti Ramarayaningar and Nemali Pattabhi Ramarao respectively.

n99c94052c42.s: In 1931, the Andhra resolution was handed to Gandhi for the Second Round Table Conference. Who went to London to press it?
n99c94052c42.x: V.V. Jogayya Pantulu went to London in 1931, while Bobbili Raja and Mocherla Ramachandra Rao attended the Second Round Table Conference.

n561b8dc0931.s: Who led the Andhra delegation that met Edwin Montagu in Madras on 20 December 1917?
n561b8dc0931.x: Nyapati Subba Rao led the delegation that met Montagu in Madras on 20 December 1917 to press for an Andhra province.

ne92b7f6b09b.s: The demand for a separate university for the Telugu people was first raised at the Andhra Mahasabha session held at:
ne92b7f6b09b.x: The separate-university demand was first raised at the first session at Bapatla in 1913, because Madras University neglected Telugu; Vijayawada (1914) only reiterated it.

n0a56c417e8f.s: The Nizam Andhra Mahasabha, distinct from the Andhra Mahasabha of the Madras Presidency, began in 1930 at:
n0a56c417e8f.x: The Nizam Andhra Mahasabha began at Jogipet in 1930 under Suravaram Pratapa Reddy; the Madras Presidency body began at Bapatla in 1913 under B.N. Sarma.

n5284dffe719.s:
Consider the following statements about the Andhra movement during 1913–1920:
1. It demanded an Andhra State and an Andhra University.
2. It opposed the use of Telugu in education and administration.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n5284dffe719.x: This propaganda phase had four objectives: Andhra State, Andhra University, development of Telugu and cultural revival. It promoted Telugu rather than opposing it, so statement 2 is wrong.

naf6ef8a255b.s: Which of the following pairs about the early Andhra movement is correctly matched?
o: Bapatla, 1913 – First formal resolution for a separate province
Nidadavolu, 1912 – First formal resolution for a separate province
Nidadavolu, 1912 – First session called Andhra Mahasabha
naf6ef8a255b.x: Nidadavolu (1912) saw the first formal resolution; Bapatla (1913) was the first numbered Andhra Conference and Vijayawada (1914) the first session called Andhra Mahasabha.

nap-history-17-2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Third Andhra Mahasabha?
o: It was held at Visakhapatnam in 1915.
It demanded a separate Andhra Province.
It was presided over by the Raja of Panagal.
nap-history-17-2.x: The Third Andhra Mahasabha met at Visakhapatnam in 1915, not Bellary. It was presided over by the Raja of Panagal and demanded a separate Andhra Province.

nap-history-17-21.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nap-history-17-21.x: Vijayanagar Gajapati presided over the 1936 Bellary convention. B.N. Sarma presided in 1913, Panuganti Ramarayaningar in 1915 and Nemali Pattabhirama Rao at the first Rayalaseema Mahasabha.

nap-history-17-23.s: Besides a separate Andhra Province, the Third Andhra Mahasabha (Visakhapatnam, 1915) demanded:
o: Madras as the capital of Andhra
the mother tongue as the medium of instruction in secondary schools
nap-history-17-23.x: The 1915 Visakhapatnam session demanded a separate Andhra Province (Andhra Rashtram) and the mother tongue as the medium in secondary schools.

nap-history-34-2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Rayalaseema Mahasabha?
o: The Second Rayalaseema Mahasabha was held at Kadapa in 1935.
The First Rayalaseema Mahasabha was held at Madras in January 1934.
The Second Rayalaseema Mahasabha was presided over by Nemali Pattabhirama Rao.
The Second Rayalaseema Mahasabha opposed a separate Andhra state.
nap-history-34-2.x: Nemali Pattabhirama Rao presided over the first session at Madras in 1934; the second, at Kadapa in 1935, was under K. Subrahmanyam.

n61bef445d57.s: When an amendment excluded Rayalaseema from Andhra University's jurisdiction, its colleges went back to:
n61bef445d57.x: The amendment excluded Rayalaseema from Andhra University's jurisdiction, and its colleges returned to Madras University.

na3dbfb4501d.s: The Sri Bagh Pact of 1937 promised Andhra University centres at Waltair and:
na3dbfb4501d.x: The Sri Bagh Pact of 1937 promised Andhra University centres at Waltair and Anantapur.

n473e2941db2.s: The Sri Bagh Pact was signed on 16 November 1937 at Sri Bagh, the residence of:
n473e2941db2.x: The pact was signed at Sri Bagh, the residence of (Kasinathuni) Nageswara Rao of Andhra Patrika.

nap-history-40-2.s: Which of the following pairs (University – Year of establishment) is correctly matched?
nap-history-40-2.x: Osmania University was established in 1918, Andhra University in 1926 and Sri Venkateswara University at Tirupathi in 1954.

nap-history-17-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nap-history-17-4.x: The Andhra Mahasabha convention met at Bellary in 1936. The first Rayalaseema Mahasabha met at Madras in 1934, the first Nizam Andhra Mahasabha at Jogipet in 1930, and the second Vishalandhra Mahasabha at Hyderabad in 1954.

nd977f46e403.s: When Andhra University was established in 1926, its headquarters was at:
nd977f46e403.x: At its establishment on 26 April 1926, Andhra University had its headquarters at Vijayawada and its teaching centre at Rajahmundry.

n781ed493fb6.s: After 1947, the Central Government went slow on linguistic states mainly because it feared:
o: a constitutional bar on language-based states
n781ed493fb6.x: With Partition, Kashmir and the princely-state question still unsettled, the Government feared linguistic reorganisation could endanger national unity.

nd0acb27f8a1.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Constitution, as it came into force on 26 January 1950, did not include a separate Andhra State.
2. Andhra State was formed before the Constitution came into force.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nd0acb27f8a1.x: There was no separate Andhra State in the Constitution of 26 January 1950; Andhra State was formed later, so statement 2 is wrong.

ndc891c88adc.s:
Consider the following statements about the legislature of the first Andhra State:
1. It had a Legislative Council.
2. Its Assembly consisted of members elected to the Madras Assembly in 1952.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ndc891c88adc.x: The Andhra Assembly consisted of members elected to the Madras Assembly in 1952, and Andhra State had no Legislative Council.

n79c6ee320ea.s: The States Reorganisation Commission announced on 22 December 1953 was headed by:
n79c6ee320ea.x: The SRC was headed by Fazal Ali, with H.N. Kunzru and K.M. Panikkar as members.

na3b574c15a6.s: After Potti Sriramulu's death, riots and police firing broke out. How many persons died in the firing?
na3b574c15a6.x: Sriramulu's death was followed by riots and police firing in which seven people died; Nehru then announced Andhra State in Parliament on 19 December 1952.

n188c5b1bf47.s: Which of the following pairs about the final Bellary adjustments is correctly matched?
n188c5b1bf47.x: On Justice Mishra's report, Bellary taluk went to Mysore, Rayadurg to Anantapur, and Adoni and Alur to Kurnool.

n9978401203e.s: Rayalaseema's grievance at exclusion from Andhra University was answered in 1954 by the founding of:
n9978401203e.x: Sri Venkateswara University at Tirupati was founded in 1954, answering Rayalaseema's grievance after it had been excluded from Andhra University.

nc9a4b159e3e.s: When the Sri Bagh Pact was implemented in 1953, Kurnool became the capital and the High Court was located at:
nc9a4b159e3e.x: When the pact was put into effect in 1953, Kurnool became the capital and Guntur the seat of the High Court.

nb19900e799b.s: Who among the following was an Andhra member of the Madras Partition Committee of 1949?
nb19900e799b.x: The Andhra members were T. Prakasam, Kala Venkatrao, Bezawada Gopala Reddy and Neelam Sanjiva Reddy; the others named belonged to the Tamil side.

n2b51834a8fb.s: Which of the following pairs (proposed capital site – supporter) is correctly matched?
n2b51834a8fb.x: Tirupati was backed by the Krishikar Lok Party; Kurnool by Congress, Prakasam's group and Rayalaseema leaders; and Vijayawada/Guntur by the Communists.

nap-history-1-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: First Governor of Andhra Pradesh – Chandulal Madhavlal Trivedi
First Chief Minister of Andhra State – Neelam Sanjiva Reddy
First Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh – Tanguturi Prakasam
First Speaker of Andhra State – Neelam Sanjiva Reddy
nap-history-1-4.x: Chandulal Madhavlal Trivedi was the first Governor of Andhra Pradesh. Prakasam was the first CM of Andhra State, Sanjiva Reddy the first CM of Andhra Pradesh and Nallapati Venkatramaiah the first Speaker of Andhra State.

nap-history-1-10.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: First Speaker of Andhra State – Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao
First Speaker of the AP Legislative Assembly – Nallapati Venkatramaiah
First Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra State – K.V. Rangareddy
First Deputy Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh – K.V. Rangareddy
nap-history-1-10.x: K.V. Rangareddy was the first Deputy CM of Andhra Pradesh. Nallapati Venkatramaiah was the first Speaker of Andhra State, Kaleswara Rao the first Speaker of the AP Assembly and N. Sanjeeva Reddy the first Deputy CM of Andhra State.

n9fd4cabb3dd.s: In 1937, the regional rift deepened because Rajaji's Madras cabinet had no minister from:
n9fd4cabb3dd.x: The absence of a Rayalaseema minister in Rajaji's 1937 cabinet deepened the existing regional rift.

nf0b8374effa.s: As Premier of Madras in 1937, C. Rajagopalachari:
o: included Rayalaseema in his cabinet and backed Andhra separation
left Rayalaseema out of his cabinet
nf0b8374effa.x: Rajaji left Rayalaseema out of his cabinet as Premier in 1937 and later made anti-Andhra statements.

nap-history-33-3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: The Sribagh Agreement was concluded on 16 November 1937.
The First Andhra Mahasabha was held in 1913 at Bapatla.
The First Rayalaseema Mahasabha was held on 28 January 1934 at Madras.
The Gentlemen's Agreement was concluded in 1937.
nap-history-33-3.x: The Gentlemen's Agreement was concluded on 20 February 1956; the 1937 pact was the Sribagh Agreement.

nb247acb788d.s:
Consider the following statements about Nehru's announcement of 25 March 1953:
1. Madras was ruled out as the capital of Andhra State.
2. The capital had to be located within Andhra.
3. Some offices could continue in Madras for a period.
Which of the above statements are correct?
nb247acb788d.x: Nehru's 25 March 1953 decision rejected Madras as capital and required a capital within Andhra, while allowing some offices to continue in Madras for a period.

n89f66b1549c.s: Which of the following pairs (movement – newspaper) is correctly matched?
n89f66b1549c.x: Prajasakthi was the communist paper. Navasakthi was socialist, Zamin Ryot backed the peasant (anti-zamindari) movement, and Krishna Patrika and others the Vandemataram movement.

n17c2d9dc3c2.s: The article 'Are Telugu people backward?' reported the ratio of non-Andhras to Andhras in the civil services as:
n17c2d9dc3c2.x: The article reported 56 non-Andhras to 8 Andhras in the civil services, and 19 non-Andhras to no Andhras in the judiciary.

ncd3715a3dd6.s: The Vernacular Press Act of 1878, popularly called the 'Gagging Act', was repealed in 1882 by:
ncd3715a3dd6.x: The Vernacular Press Act of 1878 was repealed by Lord Ripon in 1882.

neb3bcfed1e4.s:
Consider the following pairs of publications founded by Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao:
1. Andhra Patrika – 1908
2. Bharati – 1924
3. Krishna Patrika – 1907
Which of the above pairs is/are correct?
neb3bcfed1e4.x: Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao founded Andhra Patrika (1908) and Bharati (1924). Krishna Patrika was founded in 1902 by Konda Venkatappayya and Dasu Narayana Rao.

nap-history-32-17.s: Which of the following pairs (publication – person) is correctly matched?
nap-history-32-17.x: M. Narasinga Rao edited Rayyat. Konda Venkatappayya founded Krishna Patrika, Raghupati Venkataratnam Naidu is linked with Brahma Prakasika and Suravaram Pratap Reddy edited Golconda Patrika.

nap-history-11-15.s: Who is regarded as the father of the movement for the people's spoken dialect (Vyavaharika Bhasha) in Telugu?
nap-history-11-15.x: Gidugu Rama Murthy fathered the movement for the people's spoken dialect in Telugu; C.P. Brown compiled the first English-Telugu dictionary.

nap-history-19-16.s: Andhra Samvardhani Granthalayam, an early Telugu library, was set up in 1905 at:
nap-history-19-16.x: Andhra Samvardhani Granthalayam was set up at Secunderabad in 1905.

na0db77a3a6f.s: The Andhra Desa Library Association, regarded as the first state-level library association in India, was founded in 1914 at:
na0db77a3a6f.x: The Andhra Desa Library Association was founded in 1914 at Vijayawada and is regarded as the first state-level library association in India.

na79b380ec04.s:
Consider the following statements about Ayyanki Venkata Ramanayya:
1. He was the first Indian to receive the Kaula Gold Medal.
2. His slogan was "Public libraries are temples of knowledge."
3. He conducted library training camps in 1918 and 1948.
Which of the above statements are correct?
na79b380ec04.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: his library training camps were held in 1920 and 1934.

n7a6e9730a37.s: Which of the following pairs (leader – contribution to the library movement) is correctly matched?
o: Ayyanki Venkataramanaiah – Provided financial and political backing
n7a6e9730a37.x: Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao mobilised people; Ayyanki built institutions and Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao provided financial and political backing.

n7be75418c72.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: JVP Committee – Treated language as important but not the sole factor
States Reorganisation Commission – Preferred administrative convenience over language
S.K. Dhar Commission – Rejected language as the sole basis and weighed wider factors
S.K. Dhar Commission – Preferred administrative convenience over language
n7be75418c72.x: The Dhar Commission preferred administrative convenience; the JVP Committee rejected language as the basis; the SRC treated language as important but not the sole factor.

nfa7b658e6e7.s: The Congress sub-committee of November 1955 on the Andhra–Telangana question comprised Nehru, G.B. Pant and:
nfa7b658e6e7.x: The sub-committee comprised Nehru, Maulana Azad and G.B. Pant; Azad continued to oppose the merger.

n49630d0ce76.s: Which of the following pairs about the SRC recommendations for Hyderabad State is correctly matched?
n49630d0ce76.x: Marathwada was assigned to Bombay, Raichur and Gulbarga to Mysore, and the Telugu districts were to remain a separate Hyderabad State.

n8d8e1d782fa.s: During the Visalandhra debate, the Communists consistently supported:
n8d8e1d782fa.x: The Communist movement consistently supported integrated linguistic states and specifically backed Visalandhra.
